titel: RVing New Brunswick, Wheel Weighing, Miss Daisy & Premium Rentals – RV LIFE #163

einzeiler: Exploring New Brunswick, wheel position weighing, and the booming RV rental market.
kurzfassung: This episode covers camping in New Brunswick with its favorable exchange rates, and details the critical safety importance of individual wheel position weighing with Trey Selman. It also features Bob Ashcraft discussing how he turned his camper into a Smoky Mountains rental business, followed by Becky Goodell on the surging demand for premium RV rentals out west.
stichpunkte: New Brunswick offers diverse camping from dark sky reserves to horse-friendly and drive-in movie campgrounds.
The Canadian exchange rate provides Americans with significant purchasing power.
Standard platform scales miss critical individual tire and axle weight imbalances on RVs.
Overloading and poor weight distribution drastically increase the risk of tire blowouts and component wear.
Proper front-to-back weight distribution is especially crucial for travel trailers to mitigate sway.
Turning an RV into a vacation rental works well when units are permanently stationed and managed locally.
Blacksford RV Rentals has tripled its business in three years, driven by demand near national parks.

clips.hook: Crossing the border into a new time zone
clips.text: Crossing the border from Maine immediately places travelers into a different time zone, as Canada utilizes multiple regional time zones in the east.

clips.hook: The exchange rate advantage for American travelers
clips.text: A single United States dollar translates to roughly one dollar and forty-one cents in Canadian currency, offering strong economic benefits for visitors.

clips.hook: The shock of discovering an overloaded vehicle
clips.text: Travelers accustomed to passenger cars rarely consider weight limits, making the realization that their recreational vehicle is overloaded a startling surprise.

beschreibung:
From New Brunswick camping and lobster to wheel position weighing, Smoky Mountain RV rentals, and premium national park trips, this episode helps RVers plan smarter, travel safer, and understand what every pound really means.
Discover New Brunswick camping options, from off-grid dark sky stays to full-hookup resorts, glamping, lobster, and horse camping.
Learn why wheel position weighing reveals safety issues a basic truck stop scale may miss.
Hear how Miss Daisy became a Smoky Mountains RV rental business built around setup, checklists, and real-world lessons.
Understand why premium RV rentals are growing near western national parks and who is driving that demand.

John talks with Salma Burney of the New Brunswick Campground Owners Association about camping options, history, lobster, off-grid stays, and why the exchange rate may make Canada especially appealing for American RVers.
Then Jim and Rene sit down with Trey Selman from the RV Safety & Education Foundation to explain wheel position weighing, weight distribution, tire safety, water weight, and why every item you pack matters.
Rose and Glynn talk with RV Entrepreneur Bob Ashcraft about turning "Miss Daisy" into a Smoky Mountains RV rental business and writing a book to help new campers avoid expensive lessons.
Bob wraps up with Becky Goodell, CEO of Blacksford RV Rentals, on premium RV rental growth near western national parks and why more travelers want the RV experience without buying first.
